text:

metrics.description: Also called Likes on TikTok. This shows how many people reacted to your post.
metrics.name: Reactions

metrics.description: The number of comments your post received. Shows when your post is starting conversations, not just getting seen.
metrics.name: Comments

metrics.description: The percentage of people who interacted with your post compared to how many saw it. Balances views and actions to show how compelling your posts are.
metrics.name: Eng. Rate

metrics.description: How many times your video was watched. Helps you understand how much attention your video content gets.
metrics.name: Video Views

metrics.description: How many times your post was shared by others. A sign your content is reaching beyond your immediate audience.
metrics.name: Shares

metrics.description: How many unique people saw your post. Unlike impressions, each person is only counted once. Gives you a sense of how far your content spread.
metrics.name: Reach

metrics.description: The total time people spent watching your video, added up over every view.
metrics.name: Watch Time (min)

metrics.description: How long people watched your video for on average. Shows how well the video holds attention.
metrics.name: Avg. Watch Time (sec)

text: ما الجمعيات الأهلية؟ ومن يستطيع تأسيسها؟ إن كنت مهتمًا بقضية في الصحة أو التعليم أو الثقافة، فتستطيع مع زملائك أو أصدقائك تأسيس جمعية أهلية عبر المركز الوطني لتنمية القطاع غير الربحي، خلال عشرين يومًا. بدأت الجمعيات الأهلية في المملكة من ١٥٠٠ جمعية، واليوم تجاوزت ٥٠٠٠ جمعية. تابع سلسلة «القطاع الجديد» لتتعرف على أشكال القطاع حلقة بعد حلقة. قريبًا: موعدنا الأربعاء ١١ نوفمبر الساعة ١١ صباحًا. #القطاع_غير_الربحي #القطاع_الجديد #الجمعيات_الأهلية
